blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
An invoice is a simple paper, but every detail counts. It has a name, a number, a date, and a total. The little verb have connects them all.

Every invoice has one special number. It is different for each one. The customer has 30 days to pay. We have a standard template, so every invoice looks the same.

Detail matters a lot. One wrong digit can cost you one lost week. So always keep a signed copy. A clear invoice is a happy client.

items.q: What does every invoice have?
options: A name, a number, a date, and a total
items.why: "It has a name, a number, a date, and a total."

items.q: How many days does the customer have to pay?
items.why: "The customer has 30 days to pay."

items.q: Why do all the invoices look the same?
options: Because they use a standard template
Because the customer chooses the design
Because James draws them by hand
items.why: "We have a standard template, so every invoice looks the same."

items.q: The text suggests that a small mistake…
items.why: Inferência: "One wrong digit can cost you one lost week" — um erro pequeno gera um atraso grande.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: a clear invoice helps the client
every invoice has the same number
you should never keep a copy
items.why: Inferência: "A clear invoice is a happy client" — clareza ajuda o cliente.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James conferindo as notas do dia. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning. I have all the invoices for today. Let me tell you about them, one by one.

The first invoice is for Mrs. Silva. It has three items and a total of two hundred dollars. She has thirty days to pay. The number is easy: one-zero-zero-one.

The second one is for a new customer, Mr. Costa. He has only one item on his invoice, but the price is high. It is five hundred dollars. This invoice has number one-zero-zero-two.

The third invoice has a small problem. The date is wrong. It says May, but the sale was in June. I don't have the correct paper here, so I will fix it later.

All the other invoices are fine. They have the right names, the right prices, and a signed copy. I always keep a copy — one wrong digit can cost us a week. When you are ready, please sign off on the first two. Thank you.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many items does Mrs. Silva's invoice have?
items.why: "It has three items and a total of two hundred dollars."

items.q: What is the total for Mr. Costa's invoice?
items.why: "the price is high. It is five hundred dollars."

items.q: What is the problem with the third invoice?
items.why: "The date is wrong. It says May, but the sale was in June."

items.q: Why does James always keep a copy?
options: Because the boss asks for it
Because a small mistake can cause a big delay
items.why: Inferência: "one wrong digit can cost us a week" — ele guarda cópia para se proteger de erros.

items.q: How does James feel about most of the invoices?
options: Worried, because they all have problems
Calm, because most of them are fine
items.why: Inferência: "All the other invoices are fine" — só uma tem problema, ele está tranquilo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please send the invoice to the client today." An invoice is…
options: a bill that shows what to pay
items.why: Invoice = nota fiscal, o documento que mostra o que pagar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "This invoice has three ___: a pen, a book, and a bag."
items.why: Item = item; três coisas na lista são três items.

items.q: "The price of the item is fifty dollars." The price is…
items.why: Price = preço, quanto uma coisa custa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Every invoice has a unique ___ so we never mix them up."
items.why: Number = número; cada nota tem um número único.

items.q: "The customer has 30 days to pay." A customer is…
options: a person who works for you
a person who buys from you
items.why: Customer = cliente, quem compra de você.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com notas. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you sign off on this invoice?" To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will send out the invoices tomorrow." To send out means to…
items.why: Send out = enviar, mandar para fora.

items.q: "Please fill in the date on the invoice." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher, escrever a informação que falta.

items.q: "I need to double-check the total." To double-check means to…
options: check it again to be sure
items.why: Double-check = conferir de novo para ter certeza.

items.q: "The client will pay off the invoice this week." To pay off means to…
items.why: Pay off = quitar, pagar por completo.
